crossRefs.note: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

translations.web: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
translations.bsb: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
translations.kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
